title: The recipe registry: a problem as one kind plus modifiers, every choice with the part that made it
request: Phase 8, Part C (the owner's task recipes document): support new machine-learning problems by adding recipe parts, never new pipelines; every part fills one contract, is versioned and certified, and a resolved recipe says which part decided each choice and why.
plan: Write the contract in dclab_core: a recipe part with the owner's nine fields, a version and a certification level, and a resolved recipe whose choices name their part and reason.
Write the precedence the owner's document gives: the person wins, splits combine, the most specific modifier wins a one-value field, lists add up, an unsettled conflict is asked.
Read the fifteen problem kinds as parts through an adapter, and record the recipe on every run without changing what the run does.

decisions.decision: The recipe records what the run already decides; no choice moves to the resolver until the modifiers exist.
decisions.why: The package promises no behaviour change: the modifiers that change the split and the metric come with their own certification.

decisions.decision: A part's version is a fingerprint of its fields and of the source of its kind's class and every kind class above it.
decisions.why: A certification names a part's version; a change inside a method must change the version, or a certified level would follow changed behaviour.

decisions.decision: Every kind's level is experimental until a certification run earns more.
decisions.why: The owner's certified level asks for two real datasets and the same result with the model off; the capability matrix shows replicas only.

decisions.decision: A failure to resolve the recipe is recorded in the stage record, never raised.
decisions.why: The recipe describes a run; a long column name or a kind that cannot be read as a part must not stop a run that used to succeed.

change: dclab_core/recipes.py (RecipePart v1, Choice, ResolvedRecipe v1, resolve; dclab-core 0.78.0, the schemas and their baselines, the conformance reasons); dclab_rnd/recipes.py (part_of, kind_parts, resolve_for, record_for, python -m dclab_rnd.recipes); the engine records the recipe and the split it ran in the data stage, a machine kind's too; the split and metric decisions carry the part and reason that made them; tests/test_recipes.py.

findings.defect: Kinds with their own machine recorded no recipe.
findings.scenario: A segmentation run's data stage held no recipe: nine kinds never reached the line that recorded it.
findings.cause: A machine kind's prepare returns before the tabular path, and its stages never call the tabular data stage.
findings.fix: The machine branch records the recipe in its data stage, with the machine's metric and the split marked as the machine's own.

findings.defect: A part's version did not change when its kind changed.
findings.scenario: Moving the rare-class cut-off inside a kind's metric method left its version unchanged, so a certification would follow changed behaviour.
findings.cause: The fingerprint read class attributes only.
findings.fix: The version hashes the part's fields and the source of the kind's class and every kind class above it.

findings.defect: A modifier's split dropped a kind's time order.
findings.scenario: A kind that splits forward in time with a groups modifier resolved to a plain group split.
findings.cause: Only the modifiers' splits were combined.
findings.fix: A kind's forward split joins the modifiers' splits; a rolling origin with groups, which do not combine, is asked.

findings.defect: Modifiers of equal rank that disagreed were settled by their order.
findings.scenario: Two modifiers setting different calibrations gave one answer, and the other when listed the other way round.
findings.cause: The first modifier of the lowest rank won.
findings.fix: Modifiers of equal rank that disagree leave the field open and ask the person.

findings.defect: What a person stated was not checked, and some of it was dropped.
findings.scenario: A stated split of 'temporal' was accepted, which the dataset step would read as a random split; a stated list of model families vanished.
findings.cause: Stated values were copied without validation, and list fields were never read from them.
findings.fix: A stated split must be one of the contract's splits, an unknown field is refused, one-value fields take text and list fields take lists, which replace the parts' lists.

findings.defect: A run that used to succeed could fail.
findings.scenario: A table with very long column names, as survey exports have, raised a validation error inside the engine's prepare.
findings.cause: The reason built from the column names exceeded the contract's length, and the engine did not guard the call.
findings.fix: Reasons and parts are cut to the contract's lengths, and the engine records a failure to resolve instead of raising.

findings.scenario: Every part said a stratified split, regression's and places' included, and two kinds named a metric they do not run by.
findings.cause: The part read the split of an empty solution and the first metric listed.
findings.fix: A part's split is the kind's own (none for a machine kind, spatial blocks for places, strata or random by the kind), its metric the kind's default, its artifact needs only the true flags.

findings.defect: Some recorded choices disagreed with the run.
findings.scenario: The models were recorded as asked by no part while the screen tried many families, and the guard metrics listed the primary itself.
findings.cause: Only the split and the metric were taken from the run.
findings.fix: The models choice says the engine's screen chooses them, and the guard metrics are the kind's others beside the primary.

findings.defect: The no-change test compared a function with itself.
findings.scenario: The test called the same functions the adapter calls and never ran the engine, so it would pass whatever the engine did.
findings.cause: It checked the adapter, not the run.
findings.fix: Engine runs on four kinds and a machine kind: the recipe's split and metric equal the split the run recorded and its metric.

findings.defect: The package's own steps were missing.
findings.scenario: No changelog entry, version, integration section or development record for two new contracts.
findings.fix: dclab-core 0.78.0, its changelog, the integration section and this record; the split and metric decisions now carry the part and reason that made them.

outcome: Every run records its recipe, the kind's part with its version and the reason behind each choice, and the recipe's split and metric are the run's own; the precedence the modifiers will use is in place and tested.
lessons: A test of no behaviour change must run the behaviour: comparing a function with the functions it calls proves nothing.
A version that certifies behaviour must fingerprint the code that decides, not only the declared attributes.
risks: No modifier exists yet: the precedence is tested on invented parts until 30.11.
